name: OCR
recent: OCR Group 近期有一项重大诉讼，并针对 Kumpulan Jetson 及其子公司赢得法院诉讼。公司还公布了截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日止季度的业绩。此外，公司重新推介了 D'Templer 项目。
notable: 公司针对 Kumpulan Jetson 及其子公司赢得法院诉讼。
公司重新推介 D'Templer 项目。
risks: 公司涉及一项重大诉讼。
earnings: 最近一个季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收为 MYR 58.065 百万，环比下降 14.6%，但同比增长 35.3%。净亏损为 MYR 2.386 百万，净利率为 -4.1%，而上一季度为 -0.6%。

recent_en: OCR Group has been involved in a material litigation and won a court suit against Kumpulan Jetson and its subsidiary. The company also announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2025. Additionally, it rejuvenated the D'Templer project.
notable_en: The company won a court suit against Kumpulan Jetson and its subsidiary.
The company rejuvenated the D'Templer project.
risks_en: The company is involved in a material litigation.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 58.065 million, down 14.6% QoQ but up 35.3% YoY. Net loss was MYR 2.386 million with a net margin of -4.1%, compared to -0.6% in the previous quarter.
